Final review complete; no further changes needed.

State of src/dotenv/parser.py:
- Line 30: `_rest_of_line = make_regex(r"[^\r\n]*(?:\r\n|\n|\r)?")` — alternation ordered longest-first, matching `_end_of_line` (line 29) and `_newline` (line 18).
- Error path (line 170) consumes the full newline, so an invalid binding's `original.string` includes the whole CRLF, and the following valid binding starts at line 2 with `original.string == "GOOD=ok\n"`.

Behavior preserved: LF and lone-CR each match their single newline; repeated invalid lines each consume their own newline. Only src/dotenv/parser.py was modified; no tests, docs, other modules, or dependencies touched.

Limitations: none known. Host acceptance and selected upstream regression tests passed.
